evidence: Stage model verified complete: AnimalState (biology.rs:133-184) distinguishes juvenile, sub_adult, adult StageCohorts with per-stage reserve_g, condition_index, maturation_accum; berried_females_count as adult-subset; egg_cohorts with per-cohort count/progress_days.

Lifecycle transitions verified deterministic and one-way: juvenile_to_subadult (shrimp.rs:622-682) and subadult_to_adult (shrimp.rs:685-746) use deterministic_transfer_count with carry, condition gates, and reserve-funded biomass growth. Spawning (shrimp.rs:436-476) restricted to adults only. egg_development (shrimp.rs:478-585) resolves cohorts to juveniles via receive_entrants().

Feeding is stage-weighted (ADULT=1.0, SUB_ADULT=0.67, JUVENILE=0.3 at biology.rs:194-196) via feeding_units() (biology.rs:509-513). Mortality has per-stage sensitivity (sub_adult_sensitivity=1.2, juvenile_sensitivity=1.5) at shrimp.rs:748-818. All stages contribute to water chemistry via total feeding_units.

Food demand consistency verified: shrimp_feeding() (shrimp.rs:149-196) uses grazing_access_factor (line 160), and update_condition() (shrimp.rs:274-330) uses shrimp_target_food_route_g() (shrimp.rs:132-147) which also applies grazing_access_factor (line 142). The prior amendment fr-3-4901e64f is resolved.

AddShrimp handler verified: engine.rs:698-704 now calls self.state.animal.adult.receive_entrants(count, 0.0, DEFAULT_STAGE_CONDITION_INDEX) instead of direct count increment. The prior amendment fr-3-17d200a6 is resolved.

Snapshot backward compatibility verified: TankSnapshotRepr.total_shrimp_count is Option<u32> with #[serde(default)] (defaults to None); sub_adult_count has #[serde(default)] (defaults to 0). Conversion logic (snapshot.rs:176-181) reconstructs total from stage counts when None. Test snapshot_deserializes_pre_stage_payloads_without_stage_totals covers this path. The prior amendment fr-3-dce4c34e is resolved.

Save migration verified: v4→v5 migration (save.rs:432-628) seeds juvenile_to_subadult_days and subadult_to_adult_days from legacy total maturation days via split_legacy_total_maturation_days. StageCohort fields have serde(default). ShrimpRuntimeParams has struct-level #[serde(default)]. Test legacy_schema_v4_saves_split_legacy_maturation_days_into_stage_params covers this.

Invariant validation verified: validate_shrimp_runtime_params (invariants.rs:276-376) validates stage durations and condition thresholds. enforce_invariants (invariants.rs:30-55) clamps per-stage condition_index, maturation_accum, and calls clamp_berried_to_adults().

findings_or_gaps: BEAD REGRESSION: shrimp_removal_validation test fails with InvariantViolation { field: 'animal.egg_cohort_count_total', value: 0.0 }. The test (shrimp_population.rs:626-658) sets berried_females_count=2 but creates no egg cohorts. The egg_cohort invariant (invariants.rs:192-198, added by this bead) requires egg_cohort_count_total == berried_females_count. Either the test must create matching egg cohorts, or enforce_invariants should call repair_egg_cohort_counts_for_load() before validation runs on Engine::from_parts state.

CROSS-BEAD REGRESSION: save_load_with_active_cycle_state fails due to refresh_habitat_registry() added at non-daily hours in engine.rs:322-326 by bead 6e5.7.1. This changes state during continued simulation that isn't captured in the saved snapshot, causing numerical drift and RNG state mismatch on resume. Not attributable to 6e5.6.2; the diff between commit 43902e4 (this bead's cycle 2 round 3 checkpoint) and HEAD shows this change came from another bead.
CROSS-BEAD: cargo fmt --all --check reports a formatting issue in plant_nutrient_normalization.rs (last modified by bead 6e5.4.3-v2). Not attributable to 6e5.6.2.

The step_hours_leaves_state_untouched_when_clamps_precede_a_validation_error test (previously reported as failing from bead 6e5.7.1) now passes. This suggests the refresh_habitat_registry change has been accounted for in some code paths but broke the save/load determinism test instead.
follow_up_or_amendments: Fix shrimp_removal_validation test: The test must create egg cohorts matching berried_females_count=2. Add two EggCohort entries (e.g., state.animal.egg_cohorts = vec![EggCohort { count: 1, progress_days: 0.0 }, EggCohort { count: 1, progress_days: 0.0 }]) before constructing the engine. This is a one-line fix within this bead's scope.

Alternatively, enforce_invariants could call repair_egg_cohort_counts_for_load() to auto-heal the berried/egg_cohort mismatch. However, the stricter approach of requiring test setup to be correct is preferred since the invariant is catching a real bookkeeping issue.
Bead 6e5.7.1 must address the save_load_with_active_cycle_state regression caused by the refresh_habitat_registry() addition at non-daily hours.
